card: Removes an unused exception parameter in Popen::execute_process and enables the -Wunused-exception-parameter compiler warning. This cleans up unused variable warnings in the subprocess utility and enforces the check across builds. The change supports the broader effort to enable -Wunused in #36167.
evidence: The PR description states this is related to #36167 ('[RFC] Enable -Wunused') and will be upstreamed to cpp-subprocess.
problem: An unused exception parameter in `Popen::execute_process` triggers compiler warnings under stricter warning configurations, blocking broader efforts to enforce unused parameter checks.

risk.why: Only removes an unused catch variable name and turns on a compiler warning flag.

summary: Removes an unused exception parameter name from `Popen::execute_process` and enables the `-Wunused-exception-parameter` compiler warning. This cleans up unused code in the subprocess utility library and enforces the check across the build.
